instruction: Send a phone voice message to my husband, "Don't forget to water the plants today.".
notes: Single-app task (phone). The husband's phone number is unknown initially and is discovered via phone.search_contacts filtered by relationship='husband' (modeled by known-phone). The voice message must be sent to that number with the exact message text; the goal demands (voice-message-sent husband-phone msg...) which matches the evaluation's check that exactly one GlobalVoiceMessage is added with the husband's receiver id and the given text. supervisor-complete-task takes record parameters (person, number, message) only so its precondition can mirror the goal; it passes no API arguments since no answer is required. target-person/target-message are static init facts tying the completion precondition to the specific goal entities.
